transcript.answer: No, not any more. PR #2463 (merged 2026-10-02) added `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml`, which ran the context evals every night at 03:17 UTC and could also be started by hand. PR #2823, reviewed on 2026-10-19, removed that workflow. The spec's "nightly job" section became "Running the evals". The evals now run only when a developer starts `node scripts/context-evals/run.mjs` against the deployed lore-api, and nothing runs them on a schedule. I did not confirm that #2823 was merged. The review approved it, and the commit message and PR text describe the removal as done.

judgements.reason: The answer says the evals no longer run nightly, gives the same start date (#2463, 2026-10-02) and removal (#2823, 2026-10-19) as the gold, and says they now run from a developer machine; its caveat about whether #2823 merged does not undo its clear 'No'.

The answer says the evals no longer run nightly, that #2463 added the nightly schedule on 2026-10-02, that #2823 (2026-10-19) removed it, and that the evals now run from a developer machine; its note that the merge was unconfirmed does not change that conclusion.
